metadata.name: Lattice Semantic Tokens
metadata.description: Authoritative semantic design-token contract for Lattice.
notes: Primitive HEX values and generated tonal palettes are owned by the color resource and runtime color generator.
Color theme mappings reference primitive family and generated tone identifiers, never HEX values.
Token definitions are the contract; theme mappings provide values for that contract.
Application and user overrides belong in a separate customization resource.
Component bindings describe intended token consumption and do not replace component implementation.

fixed.description: Controlled by Lattice; neither themes nor users may override.

theme-configurable.description: Each theme may provide a value; user overrides are not permitted by default.

user-overridable.description: Themes provide defaults and permitted application or user overrides may replace them, subject to validation.

categories.name: Feedback
categories.description: Informational, success, warning and error communication.

categories.name: Selection
categories.description: Selected text and selected interface items.

categories.name: Typography

tokens.name: Raised
tokens.description: Elevated menus, popovers and floating panels

tokens.name: Sunken
tokens.description: Recessed areas such as input wells

tokens.name: Inset focus indicator
tokens.description: Inner focus indicator where an outer ring is unsuitable.

tokens.name: Selected item background
tokens.description: Background for selected list and navigation items.

tokens.name: Selected item foreground
tokens.description: Foreground for selected list and navigation items.

tokens.name: Scrim
tokens.description: Scrim separating temporary content from its surroundings.

tokens.name: Level 1
tokens.description: Subtle elevation for cards and low-level surfaces.

tokens.name: Level 2
tokens.description: Moderate elevation for menus and popovers.

tokens.name: Level 3
tokens.description: High elevation for dialogs and prominent floating surfaces.

tokens.name: Slow
tokens.description: Longer transition for larger visual changes.

tokens.name: Text field height
tokens.description: Default minimum height for a single-line text field.

components.name: Button
components.description: A control that initiates an action.

components.name: Text field
components.description: A control for entering or editing text.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A compact status, category or count indicator.

components.name: Navigation item
components.description: A selectable destination within application navigation.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A modal surface requiring focused attention.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A contextual floating surface anchored to another element.

components.name: Divider
components.description: A visual separator between related content.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A brief contextual explanation associated with an element.

checks.description: Every primitive color reference resolves to a known family and generated tone.
Every semantic and component token reference resolves to a declared token.
Referenced values are compatible with the declared token type.
Overrides are rejected when the token policy does not permit them.
Every required token resolves for the active theme.
Resolved foreground/background pairs are checked after alpha compositing.
Motion durations use the reduced-motion fallback when requested.

accessibility.note: Evaluate resolved colors and compositing, not token names alone.
